content.short: Ethernity is a celebrity NFT marketplace for authenticated NFTs.
content.description: Founded by Nick Rose Ntertsas and a team of builders, Ethernity is an NFT marketplace that lets sports fans browse and buy authenticated NFTs from their favorite sports celebrities. The catalog spans trading cards, short video clips, and other rare collectibles, with options to purchase outright or participate in auctions. By presenting verified digital memorabilia, Ethernity seeks to connect fans with tangible moments from the world of sports while enabling direct ownership and marketplace-style trading.
